provenance.review: L9 stock OMP 18.14.0 source review, downloaded-asset receipt and two macOS arm64 semantic rehearsals; summarized without operator paths or private captures

client_upgrade.reason: Consume the rebuilt upstream binaries and preserve the exact custom Responses selectors and compatibility settings. Runtime bytes remain unchanged in this host-free stage; the planned RTX 3090 component is rebound separately after its gates.

asset_identity.method: L9 downloaded each raw release asset and compared its SHA-256 and byte count with GitHub release metadata and SHA256SUMS.txt. These observations are imported from that receipt, not new platform executions by the staging lane.

semantic_rehearsals.execution_kind: macOS arm64 stock CLI/RPC against an owned loopback Responses stub on an ephemeral port
semantic_rehearsals.scope_limit: Both executions used the macOS binary; the second lane selector does not execute Windows or a GPU. The restarted server is a stub, not NInfer. No verbatim installation-route, editing, image-input, compaction-quality, long-loop, or final prepared-guide acceptance is claimed.

behavior_review.predicate: Default hashline adapts to replace only for a recognized Qwen revision 3.8.0 selector. The opaque q38-ninfer alias is not recognized by that family predicate.
behavior_review.lane_effect: qwen3.8-27b on native RTX 4090 and ninfer-heavy defaults to replace; q38-ninfer on RTX 3090 and RTX 5090 stays hashline. Source-derived, not an exercised edit-tool result.
behavior_review.action: Keep exact served IDs and do not force an override. Model variants win first; PI_EDIT_VARIANT pins the mode; non-hashline edit.mode is retained; PI_STRICT_EDIT_MODE prevents adaptation. An explicit settings-derived hashline alone is not necessarily a pin.

behavior_review.predicate: At the default 131072-token window, reserve=max(floor(window*0.15),16384)=19660; compaction triggers strictly above 111412. The client bounds retained history, ignores stale usage and opaque encrypted-reasoning bytes, rejects non-reducing automatic candidates, preserves main summaries when optional short summaries fail, and retains split-turn extra context.
behavior_review.lane_effect: The numeric default threshold stays; compaction cut points and prompt bytes can change. Native remote compaction/cache-target changes require opt-in not present in these fragments.
behavior_review.action: Keep defaults and the below-threshold durability seed. Do not infer production compaction quality or prefix-reuse equivalence from the semantic rehearsal.

behavior_review.predicate: model.loopGuard now reaches custom openai-responses models through the common stream-option base; the stock exact suffix-cycle detector is enabled by default. Semantic heuristics still have compatibility/model predicates.
behavior_review.action: Leave stock settings enabled; no new models.yml key or disabling override. Long-loop false positives and cutoff behavior remain unexercised.

behavior_review.predicate: Provider-qualified IDs resolve exactly; a recognized :medium suffix selects effort after exact-ID lookup. Stateful Responses, reasoning-summary and encrypted-reasoning compatibility keys remain supported.
behavior_review.action: Retain ninfer-beta/q38-ninfer, ninfer-native-3090/q38-ninfer, ninfer-native-4090/qwen3.8-27b and ninfer-heavy/qwen3.8-27b:medium. Keep statefulResponses=true, includeEncryptedReasoning=false and supportsReasoningSummary=false; clear PI_OPENAI_STATEFUL. No provider aliases or fleet-agent changes.

behavior_review.predicate: The exact 18.14.0 release-binary workflow installs Bun 1.4.4. The 18.13.0 release documents CVE-2026-91403 (compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates) and CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write).
behavior_review.lane_effect: All three client executable identities change. Retaining an old binary does not receive the bundled-runtime fixes.
behavior_review.action: Use the new asset URLs, sizes and full hashes. No independent reproducible rebuild or embedded-runtime extraction is claimed.

verdict.scope_limit: Source review and two imported macOS stub rehearsals only. Windows/Linux execution, real GPU behavior, native package upgrade/rollback, all fresh documented routes, restoration, council and publication remain separate gates.
